config.known_information: Physical exogenous clocks are unchanged. City initial stop selection uses unknown-phase headway expectation and causal queue delay, not future second-exact phase. Queue reviews retain the inherited scenario-clock information; neither is observed student tracking or validated live prediction.
config.unverified_parameters: Legacy tastes, hazards, walking and grade mappings remain prototype assumptions. Effective release lag is retrospectively calibrated on reused SNU queue constraints; not identified actual building egress.
config.forecast_seat_interpretation: One indivisible marginal person is queried AFTER the ordinary weighted FIFO forecast of people ahead. No rounding of pre-queue seats; no accumulation of fractions across departures. Physical weighted demand, capacity and actual boarding unchanged. Not a probability guarantee.
config.wait_discomfort_interpretation: Prospective increment G(A+W)-G(A) of cumulative journey waiting. Completed wait A affects marginal discomfort, never physical ETA. Same polynomial scales as V12; uncalibrated alternative hypothesis. No reset by walking to another queue.
config.random_utility_interpretation: Retain V12 fixed individual coefficients plus event-specific iid errors. rho=1 sensitivity was inferior in Tuesday pilot; no empirical serial correlation estimate.
config.initial_assignment_interpretation: Inherited initial mode retained; city users choose personally perceived fastest boarding stop using headway expectation, current causal queue delay and existing walking prior/2min utility scale. No oracle future-second phase.
config.fallback_crowding_interpretation: Known retained onboard plus this chosen vehicle known FIFO-ahead boardings plus marginal person. Historical reserved capacity is diagnostic only, never imputed as observed passengers. Entry-load proxy held over inherited ride, not full future load trajectory. Categorical grade costs unchanged.
config.walking_variation_interpretation: Restore inherited relative person-specific factors from frozen prepared.walk_scales, on top of the retained nominal4.8km/h path-local physics. No new speed distribution or random draws. Factors and nominal speed are scenarios, not SNU measurements.
config.cohort_release_interpretation: Retrospective global scaling of inherited unmeasured class-end-to-building-departure lag; same class, location, destination and mass; no departures before class end. Parameter chosen with already used reports, not independently validated actual egress behavior.
config.calibration_status: Mechanism corrections plus declared unmeasured narrower patience dispersion; reused reports assess fit, not independent field validation.
config.committed_arrivals_information: Simulation information assumption: already-started approach intent and readiness known to predictor; excludes future departures, later rerouting and realized future queue. Not measured student tracking.
config.later_walking_preference: Repeated-change terminal-walk probability retained for accessible destinations; far SNU walkers use transit/gate fallback. Personal patience and denial experience govern opportunities.
config.repeat_walk_interpretation: User-directed terminal walk probability p_n=1-(1-p_reference)^(2^n), conditional on an actual decision opportunity. Reference neutralizes only incremental count-dependent changing-action fee. Same current distance/wait/cost context; probability, not physical ETA. Not estimated from observed students.
config.scenario_scope: User-reported behavioral hypotheses; patience dispersion and short enroute encounter window are unmeasured scenarios.20min is a diagnostic, not forced abandonment. Source modal cohorts, destination and mass retained; far initial SNU walk redirected to a city-bus strategy.
config.seat_forecast_interpretation: Retain inherited causal past residual-seat proxy and actual denied-boarding experience. This is a subjective model assumption, not measured numeric onboard occupancy.
config.patience_interpretation: Fixed per person median20min with log_sigma0.1: approx95%16.4..24.3min. No hard abandonment clock; sigma is a disclosed scenario, not identified by queue snapshots.
config.same_stop_interpretation: After the existing personal/denial gate releases, compare an expanded legal same-platform pool with stay and walking choices. No forced boarding-policy expansion, reset of wait/denial/FIFO, physical return, route-change count or new service.
config.initial_trunk_interpretation: For SNU/Daehak, retain all primary commute modes allowed by the original whole policy (all pool members and their own continuations) until the existing flexibility release. Preserve first-mode cohort and patience draws. Internal access shuttles are not commuter shuttles. Apply to initial and enroute options, retain known already-boarded main mode through internal suffixes. Ambiguous source policies retain all allowed modes; proxy, not survey.
config.initial_primary_interpretation: User clarified primary destination-service boarding focus without anticipating waiting after access buses. Initial primary-stop alternatives are grouped once per primary boarding node; own continuations are split by their actual primary node. Perceived access includes first wait and prefix rides/walks, excluding subsequent transfer waiting. Actual transfer queues and all later decisions remain physical and unchanged. This is an explicit user-shaped heuristic, not total-ETA optimization or empirical preference estimation.
